content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing a similar issue. Whenever I try to download a [product_name] project to [product_name], I receive a message stating: "Cannot connect to remote device. Verify network configuration." In my situation, I can access both web servers, the [product_name] site operates normally, and I am able to download programs to the [product_name] Basis Module. This problem started today; I have successfully downloaded the [product_name] site several times before. The only adjustment to my setup was adding a serial server configured in Modbus RTU to TCP mode for reading energy meter values, and this is working as expected. Is there any advice on resolving this?

Previously, connectivity and downloads via [product_name] were successful. The setup recently changed with the introduction of a serial server utilizing Modbus RTU to TCP for energy meter data, though this new component is operating without issues.
